_comment: DEPLOYMENT CONFIG TEMPLATE -- NOT A LIVE CONFIG. No value below has been used for a real run in this pass; every placeholder must be filled in by the operator deploying a real MEPS/SITES/Stage-3b ingestion daemon. This file is read by no code in this repository today -- it documents the fields a future deployment's config SHOULD define, modeled on this package's OperationalEvidenceRecord schema (system/monitoring/operational_evidence/schema.py, SCHEMA_VERSION 1.0.0).
process_run_id_strategy: one UUID4 per daemon process start; must be unique per invocation, recorded in every record produced by that invocation

MEPS_18Z_FORECAST_INPUT.station_or_origin_identity: <forecast origin timestamp, e.g. the 18Z cycle being polled>
MEPS_18Z_FORECAST_INPUT.retry_policy_suggested: exponential backoff, max 5 attempts, log a RETRY outcome record per attempt
fields_the_daemon_must_supply_per_fetch: provider_publication_time (from the THREDDS catalog's own publication metadata, NOT assumed)

local_receipt_time (wall-clock time this process observed the publication, NEVER filesystem mtime unless receipt_time_is_mtime_proxy=true is also set and the record is excluded from acceptance evidence)

SITES_STATION_TELEMETRY.source_identity: SITES Nuolja Middle Station telemetry feed
SITES_STATION_TELEMETRY.retry_policy_suggested: exponential backoff, max 5 attempts, log a RETRY outcome record per attempt

STAGE_3B_BENCHMARK_EXECUTION.station_or_origin_identity: <benchmark run identifier / forecast origin under test>

logging_failure_policy: EvidenceLoggingError must propagate to the daemon's own operator-visible error channel (alerting/log aggregator). A caught-and-ignored EvidenceLoggingError is a deployment defect, not an acceptable production behavior.
